run_transformer_training: run the adaptive span transformer model training loop with configurable model and optimizer parameters
run_full_evaluation: run a full evaluation of the trained model on validation and test datasets in eval mode
run_distributed_training: run distributed data parallel training across multiple GPUs with checkpoint save and resume support
run_train_iteration: run a single training iteration on train and validation data with hidden state caching
run_checkpoint_resume: run training resumed from a saved checkpoint with model optimizer and logger state restored
